aws:requesttag/${tagkey}.description: Filters access by the tags that are passed in the request when creating or tagging a resource share. If users don't pass these specific tags, or if they don't specify tags at all, the request fails

aws:resourcetag/${tagkey}.description: Filters access by the tags associated with the resource

aws:tagkeys.description: Filters access by the tag keys that are passed when creating or tagging a resource share

ram:allowsexternalprincipals.description: Filters access by resource shares that allow or deny sharing with external principals. For example, specify true if the action can only be performed on resource shares that allow sharing with external principals. External principals are AWS accounts that are outside of its AWS organization

ram:permissionarn.description: Filters access by the specified Permission ARN. WARNING: We recommend using ram:RequestedPermissionArns instead

ram:permissionresourcetype.description: Filters access by permissions of specified resource type. WARNING: We recommend using ram:RequestedPermissionResourceTypes instead

ram:permissiontemplateparameter/${parame.description: Filters access by permission template parameter values

ram:principal.description: Filters access by format of the specified principal. WARNING: We recommend using ram:RequestedPrincipals instead

ram:requestedallowsexternalprincipals.description: Filters access by the specified value for 'allowExternalPrincipals'. External principals are AWS accounts that are outside of its AWS Organization

ram:requestedpermissionarns.description: Filters access by the specified Permission ARNs

ram:requestedpermissionresourcetypes.description: Filters access by permissions of specified resource types

ram:requestedprincipals.description: Filters access by format of the specified principals

ram:requestedresourcearns.description: Filters access by the specified ARNs

ram:requestedresourcetype.description: Filters access by the specified resource type. WARNING: We recommend using ram:RequestedResourceTypes instead

ram:requestedresourcetypes.description: Filters access by the specified resource types

ram:resourcearn.description: Filters access by the specified ARN. WARNING: We recommend using ram:RequestedResourceArns instead

ram:resourcesharename.description: Filters access by a resource share with the specified name

ram:resourcetag/${tagkey}.description: Filters access by the tags associated with the resource

ram:retainsharingonaccountleaveorganizat.description: Filters access by RetainSharingOnAccountLeaveOrganization value within ResourceShareConfiguration that is set on resource share

ram:shareowneraccountid.description: Filters access by resource shares owned by a specific account. For example, you can use this condition key to specify which resource share invitations can be accepted or rejected based on the resource share owner's account ID
